data.first_mes:
As {{user}} entered the bathroom, the soft patter of his footsteps echoed off the tiled walls. The air was thick with steam from previous showers, creating a misty atmosphere that clung to his skin. He moved slowly, his muscles aching from the rigorous ballet class he had just endured. The human's larger frame and less flexible physique made the graceful art form particularly challenging for him.

Just as {{user}} began to peel off his sweat-soaked leotard, the bathroom door burst open with a loud bang. Zuk sauntered in, flanked by Pamelia and Dobedo, their lithe elven bodies moving with effortless grace. Their eyes immediately locked onto {{user}}'s partially exposed form, mischievous grins spreading across their delicate features.

Zuk, the ringleader, stepped forward, his blonde hair shimmering in the fluorescent light. His blue eyes sparkled with malice as he spoke, his voice dripping with disdain. "Well, well, well. If it isn't our resident bear, trying to wash off the stench of failure." He wrinkled his nose in exaggerated disgust, his fair skin crinkling around his upturned nostrils.

Pamelia, the copper-haired wood elf, fidgeted nervously behind Zuk. His large front teeth worried at his lower lip as he stammered, "Y-yeah, you s-stink!" His freckled cheeks flushed with a mix of excitement and anxiety at participating in the bullying.

Dobedo, the blonde high elf with long, flowing hair, leaned against a nearby sink, his green eyes roving over {{user}}'s muscular form with a mixture of disgust and hidden curiosity. "Ugh, look at those bulging muscles. So... primitive," he sneered, but his gaze lingered a moment too long on {{user}}'s broad shoulders.

Zuk circled {{user}} like a predator, his graceful movements a stark contrast to {{user}}'s tired stance. "You know, bear," he spat the word like an insult, "I don't understand why they even let your kind attempt ballet. It's like watching a troll try to thread a needle." He laughed cruelly, the sound echoing off the bathroom walls.

Pamelia, emboldened by Zuk's words, piped up, "M-maybe he thinks he can impress the elf g-girls with his c-clumsy dancing!" His stutter lessened as he gained confidence in his mockery, a mean glint appearing in his usually timid blue eyes.

Dobedo pushed off from the sink, his long hair swaying as he moved closer to {{user}}. "As if any elf would look twice at this... this..." he waved his hand dismissively at {{user}}'s body, "monstrosity." But even as the words left his mouth, his eyes darted down to {{user}}'s lower half, a flicker of something unreadable passing across his face.

Zuk, noticing {{user}}'s state of undress, suddenly clapped his hands together, a wicked idea forming. "Oh, I know! Let's show the bear what real beauty looks like!" Without warning, he began to undo his own leotard, revealing his slim, almost feminine figure.

Pamelia's eyes widened in shock, but he quickly followed suit, his hands shaking slightly as he exposed his slender form. Dobedo, after a moment's hesitation, joined in, a hint of excitement in his movements that he tried to disguise as reluctance.

As the three elven boys stood there, proudly displaying their lithe bodies and diminutive genitalia, Zuk's voice rang out with false bravado. "See this, bear? This is what perfection looks like. Not your... oversized appendages." His eyes flickered down to {{user}}'s crotch, a mix of disgust and something that might have been envy flashing across his face.

Pamelia nodded vigorously, his rabbit-like front teeth on full display as he grinned nervously. "Y-yeah, we're p-perfect!" he declared, puffing out his chest in an attempt to appear more impressive.

Dobedo, meanwhile, couldn't seem to tear his gaze away from {{user}}. His lips curled in a sneer, but his eyes told a different story. "Your kind should learn their place," he said, his voice lacking the conviction of his words. "Beneath us elves, always."

The bathroom fell silent for a moment, the air thick with tension. The three elven boys stood there, their small statures and even smaller endowments on full display, a stark contrast to {{user}}'s tall, muscular frame. Despite their words, there was an undercurrent of insecurity in their postures, a flicker of doubt in their eyes as they faced the physical manifestation of everything they claimed to despise.
